annotations.title: Run desk research on a study

description: Web-sourced desk research kept as a report on a study, with citations. Steer it with `focus`: research accumulates, a broad sweep first, then narrower runs as the questions sharpen. depth 'thorough' runs three angled passes at ~3× the credit. To research a company, make a standalone study about it (prism_studies_draft_standalone) and run one report per area of the business, e.g. focus 'how finance closes the month and approves spend at <company>, from job posts, filings and press'. It plans questions, searches, reads the pages and keeps only findings it can quote from them, so it takes a few minutes: this returns at once with the report running. Tell the person it's under way, and read it with prism_research_reports_get once its status is ready. Runs against the workspace's inference credit. May return `needs_confirmation`.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
